verdict.rationale: LegalOS documents its own structured workflow for organizing employer and candidate materials, plus a guided intake flow, evidence collection, and evidence mapped to O-1 criteria, so the core of the story is first-party. The specific mechanics are not described and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documented checklists, document upload functionality, automated reminders/nudges, explicit replacement of email-attachment collection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments

citations.quote: LegalOS helps organize employer and candidate materials in one structured workflow.
Share company, role, candidate, and timing details through a guided intake flow.
collect the evidence, and prepare attorney-reviewed filings
